policy: Fallback translation paths are evaluated only for SUPPORTED claims without a strict orthology bridge. They never change or inflate strict_orthology_coverage. Every path has an explicit type and literature provenance.

Acomys cahirinus.rationale: Acomys Il10 is strongly upregulated during regenerative wound healing; a published cross-species peptide comparison reports 74.13% similarity to human IL-10.
Acomys cahirinus.caveat: Literature-supported peptide homology; not counted as provider-verified orthology.

Cynops pyrrhogaster.rationale: SHH is reactivated during terrestrial newt limb regeneration. UniProt has a reviewed Cynops SHH entry and a reviewed human SHH entry.
Cynops pyrrhogaster.caveat: Curated same-gene/protein homology; not counted as OMA/NCBI/Ensembl orthology.

Paracentrotus lividus.rationale: Paracentrotus sperm cryopreservation uses DMSO plus trehalose; independent human-biomedical literature supports DMSO/trehalose cryopreservation of human cells/tissues.
Paracentrotus lividus.caveat: Intervention-level translation, not a gene or orthology bridge.

Caenorhabditis elegans.rationale: The C. elegans claim uses an exogenous ice-binding protein; independent studies show antifreeze/ice-binding proteins improve cryopreservation in human cell models.
Caenorhabditis elegans.caveat: Exogenous intervention translation; an endogenous C. elegans orthologue would be scientifically inappropriate.
